title: (REMINDER) Legacy API Sunsets on Dec 31, 2024
label: TIKTOK SHOP · CHANGELOG
subtitle: Updated 2024-09-24
html:
Reminder

This is a gentle reminder that the TikTok Shop Legacy API has been in maintenance mode for almost 90 days. This API will be sunset by the end of the year (December 31, 2024) so it is recommended that partners migrate as soon as possible. Please refer to the migration guide on more information about the changes.
